newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler Oct. international sales up 26 pct.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler Oct. international sales up 26 pct.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said its sales outside North America rose 26 percent in October, to 19,975 cars and trucks from 15,813 units during the same period last year.
Sales in the Europe and Asia-Pacific regions posted 7,973 and 7,764 respectively for the month, reflecting the success of Voyager minivans in Europe and Jeep Cherokees in Asia.

"Due in large part to our passenger vehicle sales, Chrysler International was able to eclipse last year's sales record with two months remaining," Chrysler International Executive Vice President Thomas Gale said in a statement. "We are now on track to easily surpass the 200,000 unit sales mark for 1996."
